input.headline: Product Designer at Fernway | Accessibility and design systems
input.about: I'm a product designer at Fernway, where I work on our design system and accessibility. I rebuilt our button and form components to meet WCAG AA contrast, and I run a monthly accessibility review with engineers. Before Fernway I was a print designer for five years, so I still care a lot about typography. I'm happiest when design and engineering are in the same room.
